name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 先问这条测试值不值得写
tagline_zh: 写测试最贵的不是敲代码，是维护一堆永远不失败的断言。它先帮你砍掉没价值的用例，再管命名、结构。
tagline_en: The expensive part of testing isn't writing them, it's maintaining assertions that never fail. It cuts low-value.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 它把「这条测试该不该存在」放在语法之前，覆盖选择、断言强度。
why_en: It puts 'should this test exist' before syntax, judging coverage, assertion strength, and isolation against real Laravel.
limit_zh: 只管测试设计与评审，不教你 Pest/PHPUnit 语法——那要另查框架文档。它也不会替你跑测试或改代码。
limit_en: Covers test design and review only, not Pest/PHPUnit syntax (check framework docs). It won't run tests or edit code, just judge and suggest; without.
title_en: Laravel test review that asks if a test is worth writing
